ex.en: The lemon has a flavor all of its own.
ex.zh: 檸檬有它獨特的味道。

ex.en: This drink clearly has the same flavor as tea.
ex.zh: 這個飲料喝起來明顯有茶的味道。

ex.en: The peppermint flavor in this mouthwash is too strong.
ex.zh: 這款漱口水的薄荷味太重了。

ex.en: I like to eat chocolate flavored ice cream.
ex.zh: 我喜歡吃巧克力口味的冰淇淋。

ex.en: The soup is flavored with ginger and garlic.
ex.zh: 這道湯用薑和大蒜調味。

ex.en: We all caught flu, and so did the teacher.
ex.zh: 我們全都得了流感，連老師也是。

ex.en: Tom is in bed with the flu.
ex.zh: 湯姆得了流感躺在床上。

ex.en: I had a flu shot.
ex.zh: 我打了流感疫苗。

ex.en: They handed out flyers at the station.
ex.zh: 他們在車站發傳單。

ex.en: I saw a flyer for the concert.
ex.zh: 我看到那場音樂會的傳單。

flyer.zh: 搭飛機的人（frequent flyer 飛行常客）

ex.en: Frequent flyers can use the airport lounge.
ex.zh: 飛行常客可以使用機場貴賓室。

ex.en: Join our frequent flyer program to earn miles.
ex.zh: 加入我們的常客計畫來累積哩程。

ex.en: Tom lacks flexibility.
ex.zh: 湯姆缺乏彈性。

ex.en: This job offers a lot of flexibility.
ex.zh: 這份工作很有彈性。

ex.en: We need more flexibility in our schedule.
ex.zh: 我們的時程需要更多彈性。

ex.en: The airline plans to expand its fleet next year.
ex.zh: 這家航空公司計劃明年擴充機隊。

ex.en: The company has a fleet of 50 delivery trucks.
ex.zh: 這家公司擁有 50 輛貨車組成的車隊。

ex.en: A fleet of fishing boats left the harbor.
ex.zh: 一支漁船隊駛離了港口。

ex.en: We need flour, sugar and eggs to make this cake.
ex.zh: 我們需要麵粉、糖和蛋來做這個蛋糕。

ex.en: Mix the flour with two eggs.
ex.zh: 把麵粉和兩顆蛋混合。

ex.en: Flour is made from wheat.
ex.zh: 麵粉是用小麥做的。

ex.en: I can't find a single flaw in his theory.
ex.zh: 我在他的理論中找不到任何漏洞。

ex.en: Although she has flaws, I still like her.
ex.zh: 雖然她有缺點，我還是喜歡她。

ex.en: We found a flaw in the system's security.
ex.zh: 我們發現系統的安全性有一個漏洞。

ex.en: She is fluent in English and French.
ex.zh: 她能說流利的英語和法語。

ex.en: If he's fluent in English, I'll hire him.
ex.zh: 如果他英文流利，我就錄用他。

ex.en: Even though she grew up in Japan, she speaks fluent English.
ex.zh: 雖然她在日本長大，卻說得一口流利的英語。

ex.en: Currency fluctuations affect our profits.
ex.zh: 匯率波動會影響我們的利潤。

ex.en: There are seasonal fluctuations in demand.
ex.zh: 需求有季節性的起伏。

ex.en: He resigned and fled the country.
ex.zh: 他辭職後逃離了這個國家。

ex.en: He didn't flee.
ex.zh: 他沒有逃走。

ex.en: God knows where he fled.
ex.zh: 天曉得他逃到哪裡去了。

flourish.zh: 繁榮、蓬勃發展；（植物）茂盛

ex.en: For how long did the Maya culture flourish?
ex.zh: 馬雅文明繁盛了多久？

ex.en: Small businesses flourish in this area.
ex.zh: 這一帶的小型企業蓬勃發展。

ex.en: These plants flourish in warm weather.
ex.zh: 這些植物在溫暖的天氣裡長得很茂盛。

ex.en: The company's flotation on the stock market raised millions.
ex.zh: 這家公司在股市上市，募得數百萬元。

ex.en: The flotation is planned for next spring.
ex.zh: 股票上市預計在明年春天進行。

flotation.zh: 漂浮；浮力（flotation device：救生浮具）

ex.en: A flotation device must be worn on the boat.
ex.zh: 在船上必須穿戴救生浮具。

ex.en: Kids should wear flotation vests in the pool.
ex.zh: 小孩在泳池裡應該穿浮力背心。

ex.en: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?
ex.zh: 你曾經夢想在天空飛翔嗎？

ex.en: And on sunny days all the pigeons flew home.
ex.zh: 天氣晴朗的日子，所有的鴿子都飛回家了。

ex.en: There is a kite flying above the tree.
ex.zh: 樹的上方有一隻風箏在飛。

ex.en: I've never flown in an airplane.
ex.zh: 我從來沒搭過飛機。

ex.en: We're flying to Tokyo next Monday.
ex.zh: 我們下週一要搭飛機去東京。

ex.en: There's a fly in my soup.
ex.zh: 我的湯裡有一隻蒼蠅。

ex.en: Close the window so the flies can't get in.
ex.zh: 把窗戶關上，蒼蠅才不會飛進來。

ex.en: People in the past thought the Earth was flat.
ex.zh: 以前的人以為地球是平的。

ex.en: The child believes that the earth is flat.
ex.zh: 那個小孩以為地球是平的。

ex.en: The land here is very flat.
ex.zh: 這裡的地勢非常平坦。

flat.zh: （價格）固定的、統一的；（輪胎）沒氣的

ex.en: The taxi charges a flat rate to the airport.
ex.zh: 計程車到機場收固定費用。

ex.en: I got a flat tire on the way to work.
ex.zh: 我上班途中爆胎了。

ex.en: Daddy was in his office, under our flat.
ex.zh: 爸爸在他的辦公室裡，就在我們公寓樓下。

ex.en: She rents a small flat in London.
ex.zh: 她在倫敦租了一間小公寓。

flat.zh: 單調的、平淡的；（市場）不景氣的

ex.en: Life has been so flat since I came here.
ex.zh: 我來這裡之後，生活一直很平淡。

ex.en: Sales were flat in the third quarter.
ex.zh: 第三季銷售持平。

ex.en: The river that flows through London is the Thames.
ex.zh: 流經倫敦的河是泰晤士河。

ex.en: The Rhine flows between France and Germany.
ex.zh: 萊茵河在法國和德國之間流過。

ex.en: It wasn't water flowing through the pipes, but human blood.
ex.zh: 管子裡流的不是水，而是人血。

flow.zh: 流動、流量；（資金、人潮的）流

ex.en: The immigrants entered the country in a steady flow.
ex.zh: 移民源源不絕地進入這個國家。

ex.en: We need to improve the company's cash flow.
ex.zh: 我們需要改善公司的現金流。

ex.en: The new road will improve traffic flow.
ex.zh: 新道路會改善車流。

ex.en: This is the most beautiful flower in the garden.
ex.zh: 這是花園裡最漂亮的花。

ex.en: She is curious to find who sent the flowers.
ex.zh: 她很好奇是誰送了那束花。

ex.en: The flowers will look more beautiful in the vase.
ex.zh: 這些花插在花瓶裡會更好看。

ex.en: Are the heather plants done flowering?
ex.zh: 石楠花開完了嗎？

ex.en: These plants flower in early spring.
ex.zh: 這些植物在早春開花。

ex.en: A fallen leaf floated on the surface of the water.
ex.zh: 水面上漂著一片落葉。

ex.en: He was the first man to float in space.
ex.zh: 他是第一個在太空中漂浮的人。

ex.en: A white cloud is floating in the blue sky.
ex.zh: 一朵白雲在藍天上飄著。

ex.en: She floated the idea of a four-day work week.
ex.zh: 她提出了一週工作四天的構想。

ex.en: Let me float a suggestion.
ex.zh: 讓我提個建議。

ex.en: The flash wasn't working, so he couldn't take a picture in the dark.
ex.zh: 閃光燈壞了，所以他沒辦法在黑暗中拍照。

ex.en: Please don't use a flash in the museum.
ex.zh: 在博物館裡請勿使用閃光燈。

ex.en: The warning light flashed twice.
ex.zh: 警示燈閃了兩次。

ex.en: Lightning flashed across the sky.
ex.zh: 閃電劃過天空。

flash.zh: in a flash：一瞬間、轉眼間

ex.en: I'll be back in a flash.
ex.zh: 我馬上回來。

ex.en: The weekend went by in a flash.
ex.zh: 週末一下子就過去了。

ex.en: I left your flash drive at home.
ex.zh: 我把你的隨身碟忘在家裡了。

ex.en: Save the file on a flash drive.
ex.zh: 把檔案存到隨身碟裡。

ex.en: The ship was flying the American flag.
ex.zh: 這艘船掛著美國國旗。

ex.en: The colors of the American flag are red, white and blue.
ex.zh: 美國國旗的顏色是紅、白、藍。

ex.en: This is the flag of Japan.
ex.zh: 這是日本國旗。

ex.en: I flagged the important emails for follow-up.
ex.zh: 我把重要的郵件標上旗標以便後續處理。

ex.en: The system flagged the transaction as suspicious.
ex.zh: 系統把這筆交易標記為可疑。

ex.en: The red flag indicated the presence of danger.
ex.zh: 紅旗表示有危險。

ex.en: Late payments are a red flag for lenders.
ex.zh: 延遲付款對放款方來說是一個警訊。

ex.en: That animal feeds on flesh.
ex.zh: 那種動物以肉為食。

ex.en: Salmon flesh is pink.
ex.zh: 鮭魚的肉是粉紅色的。

ex.en: The flesh of this watermelon is too mushy.
ex.zh: 這顆西瓜的果肉太軟爛了。

ex.en: Scoop out the flesh of the avocado.
ex.zh: 把酪梨的果肉挖出來。

flesh.zh: in the flesh：本人、親眼見到

ex.en: I have seen him on TV but not in the flesh.
ex.zh: 我在電視上看過他，但沒見過他本人。

ex.en: I finally met my favorite author in the flesh.
ex.zh: 我終於見到我最喜歡的作家本人了。

ex.en: We need to flesh out the details of the plan.
ex.zh: 我們需要把計畫的細節補充完整。

ex.en: Can you flesh out your proposal a bit more?
ex.zh: 你能把提案再寫得更充實一點嗎？

ex.en: Unable to find a spatula, Tom used tongs to flip the pancakes.
ex.zh: 湯姆找不到鍋鏟，只好用夾子幫鬆餅翻面。

ex.en: Flip the steak after three minutes.
ex.zh: 三分鐘後把牛排翻面。

ex.en: Tom flipped the coin in the air and then caught it.
ex.zh: 湯姆把硬幣往空中一拋，再接住。

ex.en: Let's flip a coin to decide who goes first.
ex.zh: 我們丟硬幣決定誰先開始吧。

ex.en: He sat quietly at his desk, flipping through the yellowed photo album.
ex.zh: 他靜靜坐在書桌前，翻閱著那本泛黃的相簿。

ex.en: I flipped through a magazine while waiting.
ex.zh: 我在等待的時候隨手翻了一本雜誌。

ex.en: Ebola spreads from person to person through bodily fluids.
ex.zh: 伊波拉病毒透過體液在人與人之間傳播。

ex.en: My correction fluid has run out, so now I only write in pencil.
ex.zh: 我的立可白用完了，所以現在只用鉛筆寫字。

ex.en: Drink plenty of fluids when you have a cold.
ex.zh: 感冒時要多補充水分。

ex.en: The situation is still fluid.
ex.zh: 情況仍在變化中。

ex.en: Our plans for the weekend are fluid.
ex.zh: 我們週末的計畫還沒定下來。

flux.zh: 不斷變動（常用 in flux）

ex.en: The market is in a state of flux.
ex.zh: 市場處於不斷變動的狀態。

ex.en: Our team has been in flux since the merger.
ex.zh: 合併以來，我們團隊一直變動不定。

ex.en: The flood water reached the level of the windows.
ex.zh: 洪水淹到窗戶那麼高。

ex.en: This was a warning: the floods were coming.
ex.zh: 這是一個警告：洪水要來了。

ex.en: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.
ex.zh: 好幾間小屋被洪水圍困。

ex.en: Tsunamis swept through rice fields and flooded the towns.
ex.zh: 海嘯席捲稻田，淹沒了城鎮。

ex.en: The basement flooded after the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨過後地下室淹水了。

ex.en: Fans flooded the streets to celebrate.
ex.zh: 球迷湧上街頭慶祝。

ex.en: We were flooded with emails after the announcement.
ex.zh: 宣布之後，我們收到了大量電子郵件。

ex.en: The building has 20 floors.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓有 20 層。

ex.en: There is a toilet on the fourth floor, too.
ex.zh: 四樓也有廁所。

ex.en: I prefer hardwood floors to carpet.
ex.zh: 我喜歡硬木地板勝過地毯。

ex.en: There's a pencil on the floor near your feet.
ex.zh: 你腳邊的地上有一支鉛筆。

ex.en: Are there any direct flights between Boston and Sydney?
ex.zh: 波士頓和雪梨之間有直飛航班嗎？

ex.en: All the flights on March 30th were fully booked.
ex.zh: 3 月 30 日的航班全部客滿。

ex.en: Many flights were canceled, owing to the typhoon.
ex.zh: 由於颱風原因，很多航班被取消了。

ex.en: Flight faster than sound was thought to be impossible.
ex.zh: 以前人們認為超音速飛行是不可能的。

ex.en: It was a smooth flight with no turbulence.
ex.zh: 這趟飛行很平穩，沒有亂流。

flight.zh: a flight of stairs：一段樓梯

ex.en: Her office is up two flights of stairs.
ex.zh: 她的辦公室要再爬兩段樓梯。

ex.en: He fell down a flight of stairs.
ex.zh: 他從一段樓梯上摔了下來。

ex.en: Tom is a flight attendant.
ex.zh: 湯姆是空服員。

ex.en: The flight attendant asked us to fasten our seat belts.
ex.zh: 空服員請我們繫好安全帶。

ex.en: The price of gold fluctuates daily.
ex.zh: 金價每天都在波動。

ex.en: The policy fluctuated between two opinions.
ex.zh: 這項政策在兩種意見之間搖擺不定。

ex.en: My working hours are flexible.
ex.zh: 我的工作時間很有彈性。

ex.en: We can be flexible about the delivery date.
ex.zh: 交貨日期我們可以彈性調整。

ex.en: This plastic is light and flexible.
ex.zh: 這種塑膠又輕又有彈性。

ex.en: Yoga keeps your body flexible.
ex.zh: 瑜伽能讓身體保持柔軟。

ex.en: Our company offers flextime, so I start work at ten.
ex.zh: 我們公司有彈性工時，所以我十點才上班。

ex.en: Flextime helps parents pick up their kids from school.
ex.zh: 彈性工時讓家長可以去學校接孩子。
